guide.summary: Live documentation research found OAuth references. This is an evidence packet with an advisory setup plan; provider-specific requirements still need validation.

steps.title: Confirm the registration path
steps.detail: Open the cited documentation and locate app registration, account prerequisites, and the developer console. The agent has not signed in or created an app.

steps.title: Define the minimum permissions
steps.detail: Map each integration action to a documented permission. Confirm its sensitivity and whether it changes your approval path.

steps.title: Configure your OAuth callback
steps.detail: Locate the documented redirect requirements and code exchange. Use your OAuth library’s state and PKCE support as appropriate to the provider.

steps.title: Test one complete user connection
steps.detail: After you register the app, test consent, denial, token handling, and access to a real resource. These account-dependent operations require you.

steps.title: Confirm production and approval requirements
steps.detail: Check the policy sources and contact the provider if the approval requirement or turnaround remains unclear. Do not infer no review from missing documentation.

blockers.title: Approval applicability remains unconfirmed
blockers.detail: The retrieved pages mention review, verification, or distribution. Check the exact conditions for your scopes and audience before planning a launch.

blockers.title: Account and permission gates need a human
blockers.detail: Log in to the developer console and confirm your account role, workspace policy, and app-creation access. Public docs cannot prove those permissions.
